document.title: Digest-first review generation
document.summary: Muse Code eval runs report real token usage, and the skill groups reviews from a one-line-per-file digest with patch fetched on demand. Full-suite producer tokens fall from 6.15M to 3.85M.
document.why: The session asks for a radical cut in review generation tokens [asked](source:s3), and token usage from Muse Code runs makes that cut verifiable [measurable](source:s1).

groups.title: Muse Code token usage
groups.why: Musecode producers reported 0 tokens, so no efficiency claim was verifiable [from](source:s1).
groups.summary: `runMuseCodeAgent` exports the session and sums `model_completed` usage into the run totals, with parser and export tests.
lookFor: When the session id is missing or `muse export` fails, the run still reports `finished` with 0 tokens; a failed export is invisible in the totals.

groups.why: Grouping needs one line per file, not patch text; the CLI already owns git [as stated](source:s2).

commits.subject: Digest-first review generation
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Add digest, show, and pregroup commands so the skill groups from one
line per file and fetches patch on demand. Rewrite the skill around
the digest: truncated batched sources, one tool call per phase, and a
fetch allowance that scales with digest size. Cuts full-suite producer
tokens 6.15M to 3.85M with checks unchanged.

commits.subject: Eval: read token usage from Muse Code session export
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
muse exec --json streams progress events only; token counters live
in the durable session log as model_completed events. runMuseCodeAgent
now exports the session after a completed run and sums usage into
tokens, inputTokens, outputTokens, and cacheReadTokens, so musecode
producers report real numbers instead of 0.
